annotations.title: Change lines in a DIYA-GL book

description: Changes the lines of the open DIYA-GL book (one business's sales, purchases and bank lines): adds, changes or removes them with named edits applied in order, at most 50 a call, and saves the result in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account as the next version of the book. Answers the book's summary, the version and the figures that moved. Use this when the person asks to record a sale, a purchase or a bank line, or to correct one. A refused edit changes nothing; undo_book_change takes a saved change back. It does not file anything.
